purpose: Teach: ごちそう/居眠り/ばったり/噴水/観賞/トランペット/ガッカリ/折りたたみ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お祖母ちゃんが、本気で、絶対、ごちそう、絶対、作ってくれたよ
lines.en: Riku — Grandma actually made a seriously huge feast for us.
lines.style: Bright, excited opening. Quick pace. The kind of announcement that wants to pull him into her enthusiasm. Generous smile underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。授業中、本気で、絶対、居眠り、絶対、しちゃダメだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. But seriously — you can't fall asleep in class, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, knowing tone. Light tease buried under actual concern. Casual deflection masking care. Steady eye-contact level.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、本気で、絶対、駅で、絶対、ばったり、絶対、お前のお父さんに、絶対、会ったよ、リク
lines.en: Yesterday I literally ran into your dad at the station, Riku.
lines.style: Animated, conspiratorial energy. Slightly breathless like she's still surprised by it. Leaning in with the detail, wanting his reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 公園の、本気で、絶対、噴水、絶対、夏に、絶対、子供たち、絶対、集まるんだぜ、桜
lines.en: The fountain in the park — all the kids gather there in summer, you know.
lines.style: Quieter, more observational. Slower pace. Like he's remembering it, not announcing it. Soft trailing-off suggests he's still thinking about it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前のお父さん、本気で、絶対、盆栽の、絶対、観賞、絶対、好きなんだよね、リク
lines.en: Your dad really does love looking at those bonsai, doesn't he, Riku?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity underneath. Not mocking — actual interest in understanding him through his father. Slight upturn at the end, inviting him to explain.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 吹奏楽部、本気で、絶対、トランペット、絶対、お前、絶対、上手だよな、桜
lines.en: You're actually really good at trumpet, you know that, Sakura?
lines.style: Straightforward compliment delivered without fanfare. Slight awkwardness underneath — he means it but isn't performing. Quick, honest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 前回のテスト、本気で、絶対、ガッカリ、絶対、結果だったよね、リク
lines.en: Last test didn't go the way you wanted, huh, Riku?
lines.style: Light, wry tone that softens the sting. Not dwelling on it — acknowledging it existed. Slight smile that says she gets disappointment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の、本気で、絶対、折りたたみ、絶対、ケース、絶対、お洒落だぜ、桜
lines.en: That folded case of yours is actually pretty stylish, Sakura.
lines.style: Sincere, understated compliment. Slight pause before 'stylish' — he's searching for the right word. Genuine, not performing. Soft delivery.
